visual_action: A montage video that intercuts clips of Republican politicians Nikki Haley and Tim Scott, and Fox News anchor Neil Cavuto, speaking about President Joe Biden's pro-union policies. These speaking clips are interspersed with B-roll footage of Joe Biden interacting positively with union workers and supporters at various events, including rallies, construction sites, and factories. Biden is shown kneeling for a photo with a crowd, speaking with groups of workers in hard hats, shaking hands, and posing for photos.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is the subject of all the commentary in the video and is shown in numerous B-roll clips with supporters and workers.

on_screen_text.text: When you have a president that's constantly saying,
The unions get emboldened and then they start asking for things.
This president clearly does prioritize union jobs.
And he's made very clear here
that their pay increases have not come close to the success and the money that all of these auto companies have enjoyed.

spoken_summary: The video features clips of political opponents and a news anchor discussing President Biden's pro-union stance. Nikki Haley states that when a president says "go union, go union," the unions get "emboldened" and "start asking for things." Tim Scott claims that the first bill Biden passed "had $86 billion for union pensions." Fox News anchor Neil Cavuto observes that Biden "clearly does prioritize union jobs" and believes that "union workers deserve more," arguing their pay has not kept up with auto company profits.
audio_music: An upbeat, rhythmic electronic track plays consistently throughout the video, providing a positive and determined mood that contrasts with the critical tone of some of the speakers.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage, using quick cuts that alternate between talking-head clips of critics and positive B-roll footage of Joe Biden with workers.
central_claim: President Biden's pro-union policies are a strength, and even his critics' statements confirm his commitment to supporting American workers.
intended_effect: To make the viewer feel proud of Biden's support for labor unions and to reframe Republican criticism as an admission of his effectiveness.
